subject.title: fix(ui): apply Context Profile presets via config.patch to avoid SecretRef rejection

question: Should Context Profile presets intentionally persist through their own `config.patch` operation while preserving unrelated staged edits, rather than continuing exclusively through the shared full-config Save/Apply pipeline?
rationale: Both paths are technically viable, but choosing a distinct persistent write path changes established Control UI save semantics and compatibility expectations; source inspection cannot establish that product intent.

options.title: Confirm narrow preset patching
options.body: Keep the three-field `config.patch` path, resolve the merge conflict, and require focused upgrade/state-reconciliation proof on the rebased head.

options.title: Fix the shared form path instead
options.body: Pause this branch and repair SecretRef sanitation in the canonical full-config submission path so presets continue using the normal staged Save/Apply workflow.

recommendation.title: Confirm narrow preset patching
recommendation.body: Keep the three-field `config.patch` path, resolve the merge conflict, and require focused upgrade/state-reconciliation proof on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the Context Profile and Quick Settings interaction whose persistence semantics require confirmation.
